monsters.name: Riverguard — Palace Knight
monsters.city_book_note: Aparte eigen kaart in City Book: AC 19, HP 112, CR 5.

special_abilities.name: Martial Advantage
special_abilities.desc: Once per turn, the Palace Knight deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage when hitting a creature within 5 feet of an ally that is not incapacitated.

special_abilities.name: Brave
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Makes two attacks.

actions.name: Spear
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing, or 8 (1d8 + 4) used with two hands.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing, or 9 (1d10 + 4) used with two hands.

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning; Medium or smaller target DC 15 Strength save or prone.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Adds 3 to AC against a melee attack that would hit, while holding a melee weapon and seeing the attacker.

monsters.name: The Grey Crow
monsters.city_book_note: Eigen statblock van de leider van de Shadow Brokers uit het City Book.

special_abilities.name: Fey Ancestry
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed. Magic can't put the Grey Crow to sleep.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: Charisma (DC 12); at will: dancing lights; 1/day each: darkness, faerie fire.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: Disadvantage on attack rolls and sight-based Perception checks in sunlight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Makes two shortsword attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing. Target makes DC 13 Constitution save or is poisoned for 1 hour; failure by 5 or more also makes it unconscious while poisoned until damaged or woken by another creature.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Adds 3 to AC against one melee attack that would hit, provided the attacker is visible and the Grey Crow holds a melee weapon.

special_abilities.name: Dark Devotion
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc: 4th-level spellcaster, Wisdom (DC 11, +3 to hit). Cantrips: light, sacred flame, thaumaturgy. 1st level (4 slots): command, inflict wounds, shield of faith. 2nd level (3 slots): hold person, spiritual weapon.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing.

monsters.name: Everwold Dog
monsters.city_book_note: Eigen Everwold Dog-kaart uit de bijlage; teleportatie en Keen Hearing & Smell.
monsters.languages: Blink Dog (understands Sylvan but cannot speak)

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or smell.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing.

actions.name: Teleport (Recharge 4–6)
actions.desc: Magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Before or after teleporting, the dog can make one bite attack.

monsters.name: Hempstead Bard
monsters.city_book_note: Bard-statblock uit het City Book (afbeelding na de NPC's van Theatrium).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Makes two shortsword or shortbow attacks; may replace one with Spellcasting.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6+2) piercing.

actions.name: Cacophony (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Each creature in a 15-foot cube from the bard makes DC 12 Constitution save. Failed: 9 (2d8) thunder damage and pushed up to 10 ft; successful: half damage, no push.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc: Charisma, DC 12: at will dancing lights, mage hand, prestidigitation; 1/day each charm person, invisibility, sleep.

bonus_actions.name: Taunt (2/Day)
bonus_actions.desc: One creature within 30 ft that can hear the bard makes DC 12 Charisma save or has disadvantage on ability checks, attack rolls and saving throws until start of bard's next turn.

monsters.city_book_note: Bewerkte Bandit Captain-variant uit de City Book-kaarten.

special_abilities.name: Pack Tactics
special_abilities.desc: Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the bandit lord's allies is within 5 ft of the creature and isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Makes three melee or ranged attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6+3) slashing.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4+3) piercing.

actions.name: Leadership (Recharge after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: For 1 minute, a nonhostile creature it can see within 30 ft can add a d4 to an attack roll or saving throw if it can hear and understand the bandit lord. One leadership die at a time; ends if the lord is incapacitated.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Adds 2 to AC against one melee attack that would hit, while the bandit lord sees the attacker and wields a melee weapon.

reactions.name: Redirect Attack
reactions.desc: When a creature the lord can see targets it with an attack, the lord swaps places with an ally within 5 ft; that ally becomes the target.
